title: Work reads: end an abandoned admission wait immediately instead of parking until the permit timeout
outcome: Review round 22 (Claude Low). The admission closures check the abandon flag only before runtime.block_on(acquire_*_permit_from(...)). A request the browser aborted while it was already waiting keeps a blocking-pool thread parked for the whole admission wait (Beads: budget + 1 s; a first page can wait on Engram and then Beads in turn), then takes a permit and releases it at once. No process launches (the post-admission re-check catches it), so the impact is thread and permit churn under abort load. Follow-up: race the semaphore acquire against a cancellation signal (e.g. a tokio::sync::Notify fired from WorkReadAbandonGuard::drop, notify_one so a late waiter still sees it) for the Engram admission, the Beads list admission and the Beads detail admission, with a deterministic test per path.
